title: What Changed and Why
intro: Before Sunday's Week 7 kickoffs, the lines in three NFL games moved far enough to change 12 Lock It Up picks. Every change is listed here by game, with the original pick, the new pick and the reason. Lines are the Action Network consensus as of 6:15 AM ET Sunday, Oct 25. Every original pick stays on the record. The Cover Writer's own picks did not change; they stay locked at the published numbers. Follow The Money's one Sunday call, Over 50.5 in 49ers at Falcons, did not change either.

changes.reason: The Action Network consensus total moved from 51 to 46.5 as of 6:15 AM ET Sunday. A rerun at the current number puts The Formula on Over 46.5.
